description:
Prices a whole shopping list at each Israeli supermarket chain's online store and ranks the chains: the total for each chain including its delivery fee, the cheapest chain, the items each chain is missing, the date of the prices, and a link that opens the basket on Ramzii. Example list: "חלב 3%
2 לחם אחיד
ביצים L 12
עגבניות 1 ק"ג".

list.description: The shopping list, one product per line, as the person wrote it, in Hebrew. Quantities may lead or follow (e.g. "2 חלב 3%", "עגבניות 1.5 ק"ג"). Up to 40 lines.

name: compare_basket

data_date.description: Israeli day (YYYY-MM-DD) of the oldest price in the answer.

open_url.description: A www.ramzii.co.il link that opens this answer.

title: Compare a shopping basket
